versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Feishu Owner Transfer (Advanced) skill.
- Supports single and batch transfer of ownership for Feishu Docs, Sheets, Bitable, Mindnote, and files.
- Enables Wiki space scanning and ownership transfer for linked documents (excluding Wiki nodes themselves).
- Provides both lark-cli and Python requests scripts for flexible integration.
- Automatically skips files with a human owner.
